Correction pass. Regenerate the pneumothorax mask surrogate and strictly enforce all constraints.
Target: pneumothorax
Hard requirements:
- Exact input resolution
- Background every pixel must be #00FF00
- ROI every pixel must be #FFFFFF
- Exactly two colors in output
- No labels/text/graphics
Clinical rule: include only pleural air space consistent with pneumothorax; exclude all non-target structures and artifacts.
Exclusions (strict): normal lung, mediastinum/heart, ribs/clavicles/scapulae, skin folds, lines/tubes, and external overlays.
If any requirement cannot be met, still output the best compliant two-color mask image.
Low-contrast constraint: avoid scattered micro-islands; prefer one contiguous ROI when clinically plausible.
Minimum ROI area fraction: 0.0
Maximum ROI area fraction: 0.8
Minimum connected components: 1
Maximum connected components: 1024
Tool mode: image grounding enabled. Use external examples only as conceptual guidance, not as masks.
NanoBanana image-generation mode: return one generated image only, with no markdown, JSON, or explanatory text.
